_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_leera: The Gift

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Leera arrives at the workshop with an unusual expression]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Jack. I need you to build something for me.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: An expedition scanner. Longer range than anything we have.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You spend the afternoon building it together]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: You didn't ask why. You just... started building.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Nobody's ever just... helped like that. No questions.

options.text: Your expeditions keep this town safe. It's worth building.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: ...I'm really glad you came to Coppervale.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Like, REALLY glad. Don't make me say it twice.
